services.title: Our Capabilities
services.subtitle: We don't just write code; we solve complex operational bottlenecks. Explore our specialized engineering divisions designed to modernize and scale your online presence.

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.text: Off-the-shelf software often forces organizations into restrictive workflows. When user concurrency spikes or data models become complex, generic CMS platforms crash.

architecture.title: OUR ARCHITECTURE
architecture.text: We engineer custom single-page applications (SPAs) and dynamic server-side rendered (SSR) web apps from scratch. Utilizing React, Next.js, and Node.js, we decouple the frontend from the backend (headless architecture) for extreme scalability.

outcome.title: THE OUTCOME
outcome.text: A lightning-fast, tailored interface that perfectly mirrors your business processes with guaranteed 99.9% uptime under high traffic loads.

service02.tagline: UNIFIED DIGITAL PLATFORMS FOR PROGRESSIVE INSTITUTIONS.
service02.title: School Management Ecosystems

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.text: Schools typically juggle disjointed systems: one for grades, another for finance, another for SMS. This creates massive data silos and administrative friction.

architecture.title: OUR ARCHITECTURE
architecture.text: We deploy unified centralized portals. Our systems integrate strict role-based access control, real-time fee payment gateways (including Mobile Money), automated report generation, and bulk SMS pipelines.

outcome.title: THE OUTCOME
outcome.text: An institution running at peak efficiency, reducing administrative burden by up to 60% and providing radical transparency to parents and leadership.

service03.tagline: YOUR ENTERPRISE IN THE PALM OF THEIR HANDS.
service03.title: Native & Hybrid Mobile Apps

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.text: Mobile users demand sub-second load times and native feel. Poorly ported web-to-mobile apps destroy brand credibility and suffer high uninstall rates.

architecture.title: OUR ARCHITECTURE
architecture.text: We build rigorous cross-platform (React Native/Flutter) and pure Native (Swift/Kotlin) applications. We implement offline-first data caching and strict state management to handle poor network conditions common in emerging markets.

outcome.title: THE OUTCOME
outcome.text: Fluid, engaging mobile experiences that achieve 5-star ratings and operate flawlessly across all Android and iOS devices.

service04.tagline: IMPENETRABLE DEFENSE LINES FOR SENSITIVE DATA.
service04.title: Cybersecurity & Auditing

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE
challenge.text: As operations digitize, attack surfaces expand. A single vulnerability can lead to catastrophic financial and reputational ruin.

architecture.title: OUR ARCHITECTURE
architecture.text: Security is not a plugin — it's a core principle. We conduct aggressive penetration testing, implement zero-trust network boundaries, OAuth2/OIDC SSO integrations, and AES-256 database encryption.

outcome.title: THE OUTCOME
outcome.text: Absolute peace of mind. Your data lakes and user credentials remain protected against modern attack vectors and ransomware.

service05.tagline: TURNING RAW DATA INTO STRATEGIC CLARITY.
service05.title: Data & Analytics Dashboards

challenge.title: THE CHALLENGE

mayele-booking.title: Mayélé Booking
mayele-booking.description: A reservation platform built for event hall owners in Kinshasa to manage bookings, availability, and client communication from a single dashboard.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Event hall owners in Kinshasa were coordinating reservations by phone and paper registers, which made it easy to double-book a date or lose track of which halls were available on short notice.

solution.title: The Architecture
solution.content: We built a Laravel and Tailwind CSS platform centered on a professional admin panel — a dark navy and gold design with an Alpine.js accordion sidebar for grouped navigation, a live dashboard summarizing upcoming reservations, and charts tracking booking activity over time.

features: Admin dashboard with stats and activity feed
Grouped, collapsible navigation for multi-hall management
Client communication tools built into each reservation

proconnect.title: ProConnect
proconnect.description: A production marketplace connecting clients, independent artisans, and job seekers across the Democratic Republic of Congo, built around three areas: services, job listings, and a directory of artisans.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Clients, artisans, and job seekers in the DRC had no single trusted place to find each other — services were arranged informally, and there was no structured way for artisans to build a track record or for job seekers to browse and apply to listings online.

solution.title: The Architecture
solution.content: We built a Laravel 12 platform with three integrated marketplaces (services, jobs, and artisans), a freemium subscription model with progression levels for artisans, and native Mobile Money payments through K-PAY. It's deployed in production on a self-managed VPS (Nginx, PHP, MySQL), and we ran a dedicated security pass covering IDOR fixes, CV access controls, brute-force protection, and hardened HTTP headers.

features: Three integrated marketplaces: services, jobs, artisans
Freemium subscriptions with artisan progression levels
Production security hardening (IDOR, brute-force protection, CV access control)

penepene.title: PenePene
penepene.description: A multi-vendor marketplace platform — tagline "Tout proche." (Right nearby) — connecting buyers with verified local sellers across several cities in Africa.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Buyers looking for everyday goods — electronics, vehicles, shoes, and clothing — across DRC cities had no trusted, structured place to find verified local sellers, negotiate directly, and arrange delivery, and sellers had no simple way to list products and reach nearby buyers.

solution.title: The Architecture
solution.content: We built a Laravel and Tailwind CSS marketplace where buyers browse listings by category, then message sellers directly through an in-app chat to negotiate before ordering and arranging delivery. The platform ships in French, English, Lingala, and Kiswahili, with delivery defaulting to Kinshasa and support for over 20 cities.

features: Categories spanning electronics, vehicles, shoes, and apparel
Interface in French, English, Lingala, and Kiswahili

ngt.title: New Generation Translator
ngt.description: A brand identity and multi-page animated website for New Generation Translator (NGT), a Kinshasa-based document translation service for DRC students applying to study abroad.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: NGT needed a professional online presence and a visual identity built from scratch — one that would build trust with students and families preparing important, often stressful, study-abroad applications.

solution.title: The Architecture
solution.content: We designed the brand identity, including the logo, and built a full multi-page animated site with client-side routing, custom cursor effects, page transitions, and scroll reveals — with a FastAPI and MySQL backend planned for the next phase to handle submissions directly.

features: Multi-page animated site with client-side routing
Custom cursor effects & scroll reveal animations

howWeWork.title: How We Build Your Vision
howWeWork.subtitle: A proven engineering lifecycle designed for clarity and quality at every step.

phase1.title: Discovery & Architecture
phase1.desc: We conduct deep technical discovery sessions to map your business logic, define system architecture, choose the optimal tech stack, and deliver a detailed project blueprint before writing a single line of code.

phase2.title: UI/UX Design
phase2.desc: Our design team crafts high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma. Every screen is reviewed with you before development begins — guaranteeing zero design surprises at handoff.

phase3.title: Agile Development
phase3.desc: Engineers work in tight two-week sprints pushing to a live staging URL after every iteration. You get a working, testable build at the end of each sprint with full CI/CD pipeline automation.

phase4.title: QA & Security Hardening
phase4.desc: We run comprehensive test suites — unit, integration, and end-to-end. Penetration testing and vulnerability scanning are performed before any public launch to ensure zero-trust security from day one.

phase5.title: Deployment & Launch
phase5.desc: We orchestrate zero-downtime deployments to your cloud infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless pipelines. DNS, SSL certificates, CDN configuration, and load balancing are all handled for you.

phase6.title: Post-Launch Support
phase6.desc: After go-live, our team remains on standby for 30 days at no extra cost. We monitor uptime, fix bugs within 24 hours, and provide detailed analytics reports so you can make informed product decisions from day one.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your project with NovaCore.

q1.q: Do you work with clients outside Uganda?
q1.a: Absolutely. NovaCore Technology works with clients across East Africa and internationally. We collaborate fully remotely using tools like Slack, Notion, Figma, and GitHub. Timezone differences have never been a blocker for us — we adapt to your schedule.

q2.q: What industries do you specialize in?
q2.a: We have deep expertise in Education (school management systems), Fintech (dashboards and payment platforms), Healthcare (patient management apps), Government & NGOs, and E-commerce. However, our engineering approach adapts to any industry that needs scalable digital infrastructure.

q3.q: How do I get started with NovaCore?
q3.a: Simply fill out our contact form or email us directly at novacoretechnology37@gmail.com. We'll schedule a free 30-minute technical discovery call within 24 hours to understand your requirements, timeline, and budget before proposing a solution.

q4.a: Yes. Every project includes a 30-day free post-launch support window for bug fixes and minor adjustments. After that, we offer flexible monthly maintenance retainers covering security patches, performance optimization, feature updates, and 24/7 uptime monitoring.

q5.q: Can I see examples of your previous work?
q5.a: Yes — visit our Portfolio page to see detailed case studies of our completed projects including school management systems, fintech dashboards, mobile apps, and enterprise platforms. We can also provide private demos and client references upon request during our discovery call.

q1.q: How much does a typical project cost?
q1.a: Project costs vary significantly based on complexity, features, and timeline. As a baseline: simple web applications start from $1,200, mobile apps from $2,000, and enterprise systems from $3,500. Use our interactive Project Estimator tool on this website for a personalized baseline range, then contact us for a detailed formal quote.

q2.q: What payment structure do you use?
q2.a: We use a milestone-based payment structure designed to protect both parties: 40% upfront to begin work, 40% at mid-project milestone (after design approval and core development), and 20% upon final delivery and your approval. We accept bank transfers, Mobile Money (MTN & Airtel), and international wire transfers.

q3.q: Do you offer payment plans for startups?
q3.a: Yes. We understand that promising startups often have limited initial capital. We evaluate startup payment plans on a case-by-case basis. In some cases, we also consider equity-for-service arrangements for exceptional early-stage ventures with strong business models. Contact us to discuss.

q4.q: Are there any hidden costs after delivery?
q4.a: No hidden costs — ever. Every proposal includes a fully itemized cost breakdown covering design, development, testing, and deployment. Third-party costs like hosting, domain registration, and SMS gateway fees are always listed separately and transparently in your project proposal.

q1.q: What tech stack do you use?
q1.a: Our core stack includes React and Next.js for web frontends, Node.js and Laravel for backends, PostgreSQL and MySQL for databases, React Native and Flutter for mobile, and AWS for cloud infrastructure. We choose the optimal stack for each project's specific performance and scalability requirements rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all approach.

q2.q: Will I own the source code after delivery?
q2.a: Yes — 100%. Upon final payment, full intellectual property rights and source code ownership transfer completely to you. We provide a clean, documented GitHub repository with complete commit history, README documentation, and deployment guides so your internal team can maintain it independently.

q3.q: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
q3.a: Yes. API integration is one of our core competencies. We have successfully integrated with Mobile Money APIs (MTN, Airtel), banking systems, government databases, SMS gateways, ERP platforms, and various third-party SaaS tools. We conduct a technical audit of your existing systems during the discovery phase.

q4.q: Do you build for offline use?
q4.a: Yes — especially for mobile applications targeting East African markets where network connectivity can be inconsistent. We implement offline-first architecture using local data caching, background sync, and conflict resolution strategies so your app remains fully functional without an internet connection.

q5.q: What hosting and infrastructure do you recommend?
q5.a: For most projects we recommend AWS or DigitalOcean for backend infrastructure, Vercel or Netlify for frontend deployments, and Cloudflare for DNS and DDoS protection. We handle the full server setup, SSL configuration, and CI/CD pipeline during deployment — you don't need any technical knowledge to manage it.

q1.q: How long does a typical project take?
q1.a: Timelines depend on scope: simple web applications typically take 3-5 weeks, mobile apps 6-10 weeks, and complex enterprise systems 10-16 weeks. We provide a detailed project timeline with milestones in our proposal so you always know exactly where we are in the process.

q2.q: How do you handle project communication?
q2.a: Every client gets a dedicated Slack channel with their lead developer and project manager. We conduct weekly video check-ins, provide access to a live staging environment from week two onwards, and use Notion for shared project documentation. You are never left guessing about progress.

q3.q: What happens if I want to change requirements mid-project?
q3.a: We follow an Agile methodology that accommodates change requests. Minor adjustments within the original scope are handled at no extra cost. Significant scope changes are documented in a formal Change Order with a revised timeline and cost estimate — always approved by you before implementation.

q4.q: Do you work on existing codebases or only new projects?
q4.a: Both. We frequently take over legacy codebases for modernization, performance optimization, and security hardening. We conduct a full technical audit first to assess code quality, security vulnerabilities, and architectural limitations before proposing a remediation roadmap.

q1.a: Absolutely. We sign Non-Disclosure Agreements as standard practice before any sensitive business information is shared during the discovery phase. We treat all client data, business logic, and system architecture details with strict confidentiality — always.

q2.q: How do you handle our users' data and privacy compliance?
q2.a: We engineer with data privacy as a core principle, not an afterthought. All systems are built with secure data handling practices, AES-256 encryption for sensitive data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit, and strict role-based access controls to ensure only authorized personnel can access sensitive information.

q3.q: What happens to our data if we end the relationship with NovaCore?
q3.a: You retain 100% ownership of all your data at all times. Upon project completion or contract termination, we provide a complete data export in standard formats, remove all client data from our systems within 30 days, and deliver full documentation so you can migrate to any other provider or internal team without friction.
